description: Will this Hugging Face model run on this hardware, how fast, with which quant, and with what command? Checks the repo and its quantized derivatives (GGUF / MLX / AWQ / FP8) from their real file sizes and tensor headers. Returns the best variant and alternatives, each with: verdict (fits | fits-tight | offload | no | unknown), decode and prefill tokens/sec as a calibrated range (lo/mid/hi with basis), longest context that fits, memory placement (VRAM / RAM / SSD) and an exact llama.cpp / vLLM / MLX launch command.

ctx.description: context length in tokens to fit (default 32768).

repo.description: Hugging Face repo id, e.g. "Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B" or "unsloth/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-GGUF".

name: modelread_mcp_estimate_fit
